description: Separate from provider UFCalendar metadata. Only independently checked complete UFC fight listings with source-linked bout-by-bout identities may establish full-career verification. No fighter is independently certified merely because every currently known UFC fight is indexed and measured. Minimum-count evidence may prove historical omissions but cannot certify full-career completeness, even if its minimum is met.

bruno-gustavo-da-silva.note: UFC official flyweight Bruno Silva (NOT middleweight Bruno Silva 'Blindado') lists 12 UFC appearances through 6 June 2026, including losses to Charles Johnson and Edgar Chairez in 2026; the immutable approved roster snapshot has a stale 2025-10-18 most-recent UFC date. This is a minimum count/source-confirmed gap, never independent full-career certification. The complete dated bout inventory lives in data/ufc-official-career-bout-inventory.json.

sourceSnapshot.method: Cross-checked all seven relevant complete UFCStats-derived Greco fight-result rows and event dates against the current seven-bout detailed official UFC.com career biography, distinct from UFCalendar's native research cache. UFCStats URLs are linked from the historical source CSV and were not directly rendered.
sourceSnapshot.independentNameCandidates: One Carlos Hernandez fighter identity in the pinned UFCStats fighter-details CSV; verified against exact seven UFC.com bouts, flyweight class, event dates and outcomes.

carlos-hernandez-7.nativeIdentityReconciliation: Six older UFC bouts carry historical UFCalendar numeric fighter ID 1071; 2025-05-17 Park bout carries new ID 102973. Exact dates, opponent names, official results, individual source links and native corner/winner identities independently reconcile these as one athlete. Preserve both source identities without overwriting provider records.

carlos-hernandez-7.note: Seven completed official UFC flyweight fights and seven unique, measured native links, with no source-only or cache-only UFC bouts. Official UFC.com 2026-11-14 career narrative separately lists the earlier DWCS bout; it is excluded. One native 2023-12-10 date reflects UTC displacement relative to 2023-12-09 UFCStats event date; name-order difference HyunSung Park / Park Hyun-sung is independently reconciled through one native fight ID and both corners. No claim of direct access to blocked UFCStats pages.

park-hyun-sung.note: Official UFC history shows five UFC fights across 2023-2025. Two 2022 Road to UFC qualifying bouts are excluded from UFC-only count. Only two UFC bouts currently saved.
